newsitem.title: CANADA: IIMA chief calls 110 yen to dollar range desirable.
newsitem.headline: IIMA chief calls 110 yen to dollar range desirable.

text.p: President of the Institute for International Monetary Affairs in Tokyo, Toyoo Gyohten, said on Saturday that a level of 110 yen to the dollar was very desirable.
"It's very desirable when the (Japanese) currency is around the range of 110," said Gyohten, a former vice minister of finance for international affairs in Japan.
Following his speech to delegates at the 39th annual Congress of the Association Cambiste Internationale (ACI), Gyohten told reporters that the yen could appeciate against the U.S. dollar.
"I think the yen can go up a bit more," he said.
But he said most people were happy with the current level. "There are not many people who are unhappy with where (the yen) is," he said.
On Friday, the dollar closed at 116.20/30 yen in New York trading.
